version: ADE Brain service 1.0.0 (private code), evaluation instance
mode: self-hosted evaluation instance, empty before the import, reached over REST (voice door)
door: POST /sofia/ask {query, sources: [working, semantic, episodic, conversations, files], include_raw: true}, text as the voice client hears it: a latest-events block (from /memory/episodic/recent) around the summary, card first
results: the Brain's own retrieval limits (not stated); latest-events block of up to 8 lines; cut at 2400 characters, the voice client's budget (adebench default)
model: gemini-3-flash-preview (Google): writes each entity's card from the facts it holds; episode distillation runs in the background and had not run on any of the 4 episodes when the benchmark read the memory
not_default: decay off (evaluation instance); BRAIN_LANG=en, the golden set's language; the set's repository indexed at the full-text stage only (folder summaries need the model and are not part of the set)
